title: Tailrd applicant profile
description: The canonical user profile the extension autofills job applications from. Mirrors the TypeScript UserApplicationProfile in src/shared/types.ts and the payload of GET /api/user/application-profile. Every string field is REQUIRED but may be the empty string — the filler treats "" as "no answer on file" and skips the field rather than writing a blank, so a partially-complete profile is always valid.

firstName.description: Given name. Fills firstName and, joined with lastName, fullName.

email.description: Contact email. Also the default username on ATS account-creation walls.

phone.description: Phone number as the user writes it. Workday splits a number into three controls; only this one takes the digits — the dialing prompt takes the country name and the device type answers "Mobile" (see adapters/workdaySelectors.ts).

location.description: Free-text "City, Region, Country". The fallback source for addressCity and country when those are blank — the last comma segment is read as the country.

addressStreet.description: Street line of the mailing address.

addressCity.description: City. Falls back to the first segment of `location` when blank.

addressState.description: State / province, as the ATS spells it ("ON", "Ontario").

country.description: Country name, NOT an ISO code — ATS dropdowns list names ("Canada", and "Canada (+1)" for dialing prompts), and the option matcher resolves both from the name.

currentCompany.description: Present employer. Also fills the first row of a Workday work-experience section.

workAuthorization.description: Free text answering "Are you legally authorized to work in X?". Kept as prose, not a boolean, because ATSs word the question and its options very differently.

requiresSponsorship.description: Answer to "Will you now or in the future require sponsorship?". Yes/No wording is matched against whatever options the site offers.

dateOfBirth.description: ISO date. The one field here that exists so an age gate ("Are you 18 or older?") is computed from a fact rather than recalled from a previously-answered question. Blank is normal and makes every age resolver abstain, leaving those questions for the user. A partial date ("1998-04", "1998") is answered only when the whole window agrees.

education.description: Most recent first. A repeating ATS education section is expanded to fit this list (see repeatingSections.ts).

experience.description: Most recent first. A repeating ATS work-experience section is expanded to fit this list.

skills.description: Skill names. Multi-select widgets add these one chip at a time, capped at 12 per field.

coverLetter.description: Default cover-letter text used when no job-specific letter has been generated.

salaryExpectation.description: Optional. Free text or a range; bucketed option sets ("$90,000-$110,000") are resolved by numeric containment.

willingToRelocate.description: Optional screening answer. "Yes" / "No"; blank means not answered and the question is left for the user.

workPreference.description: Optional screening answer — the applicant's preferred work arrangement.

noticePeriod.description: Optional screening answer. Free text — how much notice the applicant must give their current employer.

earliestStartDate.description: Optional screening answer. The AVAILABILITY date ("when can you start?"), never an employment-history start date.

yearsOfExperience.description: Optional screening answer. The applicant's headline total, as a string; a bucketed option set ("5-7 years") is resolved by numeric containment. NOT an answer to "years of experience with X".

languages.description: Optional screening answer — SPOKEN languages, not programming languages (those are `skills`).

school.description: Institution name as it should appear on the application.

degree.description: Degree and field, e.g. "BSc Computer Science".

startDate.description: ISO-ish YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD. Workday's segmented month/day/year widget is driven from these parts; other formats are written verbatim.

endDate.description: Same format as startDate. Empty string means the role is current.

description.description: Role summary for a free-text description box.

eeoAnswers.description: Optional demographic answers. These NEVER leave the device: they are excluded from every backend request, and a question with no answer here is left blank rather than guessed. Values are free text matched on-device against the site's own options.

examples: I am not a protected veteran
No, I do not have a disability
